top_signals.title: RBNZ More Likely To Wait Until December to Hike, Silk Says
top_signals.summary: New Zealand’s central bank is more likely to wait until December before raising interest rates again, according to Assistant Governor Karen Silk.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Fading Cobalt Rally Is Testing Congo’s Efforts to Control Prices
top_signals.summary: Cobalt’s spectacular rally is reversing as the Democratic Republic of Congo’s exports of the battery metal pick up under a strict new regime, testing the top producer’s efforts to control prices.
